reserveReview.rationale: Same-block reads at XDC block 107486464 (2026-09-21T08:32:46Z) measured 25,407,276.931021 psXDC, 7,471,325.302965 WXDC, and 0.068541 CGO in the three CollateralTokenAdapters. The protocol's XDC/USD aggregator returned $0.0283429 and its CGO/USD aggregator returned $139.619 at the same block. Applying Fathom's one-for-one psXDC-as-XDC valuation produced collateral values of $720,115.91, $211,759.03, and $9.57, or 77.275%, 22.724%, and 0.001% after rounding. An exhaustive LogInitCollateralPoolId follow-up from block 104920354 through 107486464 returned no new pool, so the three previously enumerated pools remain the full composition.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Same-block on-chain CollateralTokenAdapter balances and protocol oracle prices at XDC block 107486464
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Pool identities, balances, and protocol valuation weights are measured at XDC block 107486464. Weights can change after that block, and psXDC retains Fathom's one-for-one XDC valuation because the protocol has no separate psXDC exchange-rate feed.
